info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Business Control By Param1-spec
info.description: The Business Control Update API allows organizations to modify business control parameters for specific business units. By using this endpoint, users can efficiently manage and update operational parameters associated with business units identified by 'param1'. This API is particularly beneficial for financial institutions that need to adapt their business control settings in response to changing regulatory or operational requirements. Typical consumers include system integrators and financial analysts who require dynamic management of business control settings to optimize performance.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific business unit identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields in the request to modify the existing information.
